info.title: Energy & Utilities Integrations API
info.description: Use the Energy and Utilities Integrations APIs to integrate the Energy and Utilities Cloud apps with external billing systems.

post.description: Creates a customer's account in the billing system, based on the customer interaction via Salesforce.

requestDateTime.description: The timestamp of the request. The default value is the current date or time when the transaction is initiated.

phoneAreaCode.description: Area code of the account phone number.

billingHouseNumber.description: House number of the account per the billing address.

mobilePhone.description: Mobile phone number of the account.

mobilePhoneAreaCode.description: Area code of the account mobile phone number.

billingFrequency.description: Frequency of billing, such as monthly or quarterly.

mailingHouseNumber.description: House number of the mailing address.

externalAccountId.description: The external account that the bill is tagged to.

get.description: Retrieves the current balance, latest bill, and payment amounts for a specified account from the given date.

parameters.name: balanceDate
parameters.description: The date when the balance is requested. If the balanceDate property isn’t specified, the default value is the current date.

schema.description: The date when the balance is requested. If the balanceDate property isn’t specified, the default value is the current date.
Response parameters for the account balance.

currentBalance.description: Amount that’s owed, which includes the current balance and overdue balance.

nextPaymentDueDate.description: Due date for the next payment. If the due date for the next payment isn’t applicable, then no response is provided.

minimumAmount.description: Minimum payment amount required to avoid collection action.

minimumPaymentDate.description: Due date for the minimum payment to avoid collection action.

currencyCode.description: Currency mnemonic specified for the price, which follows the ISO 4217:2015 standard.

nextPaymentAmount.description: Amount applicable if billed but not paid. If a zero account balance is found or the amount is paid, then no response is provided.

currencyCode.description: The currency mnemonic specified for the price, which follows the ISO 4217:2015 standard.

taxAmount.description: The monetary amount of the tax. This property is used when the tax isn't a separate line item.
